required_fields.checkpoint_id: stable id assigned before H001 held-out metric inspection
required_fields.created_by_command: exact Docker command that produced the checkpoint
required_fields.feature_audit_manifest: feature audit manifest path and hash
required_fields.h001_eval_metric_seen_before_selection: must be false for paper-result eligibility
required_fields.notes: free text for non-selection operational details
required_fields.paper_result_eligible: true only for official BLIP TopK5/scales3 full-route checkpoints
required_fields.selection_reason: predeclared reason, not based on H001 held-out metrics
required_fields.train_split_manifest: filtered train split/preprocess manifest path and hash
required_fields.training_internal_metric_source: training/validation metric source, if used for selection
required_fields.training_log_path: log path under logs/ or Open3DSG output dir
required_fields.validation_split_manifest: filtered validation split/preprocess manifest path and hash
